# Icon

<p class="gls-text-lead">Place scalable vector icons anywhere in your content.</p>

UIkit comes with its own SVG icon system and a comprehensive library, which comprises a growing number of elegant outline icons. This component injects SVGs into the site, so that they adopt color and can be styled with CSS.

---

## Usage

Make sure to include the icon library script, for more details see the [installation instructions](https://getuikit.com/docs/installation).

```html
<script src="uikit/dist/js/uikit-icons.min.js"></script>
```

To apply this component, add the `gls-icon` attribute to a `<span>` or `<a>` element. To display the actual icon, you need to append the `icon: NAME` parameter to the attribute. Et voilà, you have a vector icon that inherits color just like your text does.

```html
<span gls-icon="icon: check"></span>

<a href="" gls-icon="icon: heart"></a>
```

If `icon` is the only option in the attribute value, you can also use `gls-icon="NAME"`

```html
<span gls-icon="heart"></span>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<span class="gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="check"></span>

<a href="" gls-icon="heart"></a>
</div>

```html
<span class="gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="check"></span>

<a href="" gls-icon="heart"></a>
```

---

## Ratio

Add the `ratio: 2` parameter to the `gls-icon` attribute to double its size – or any other number, depending on how big you want your icon to be.

```html
<span gls-icon="icon: check; ratio: 2"></span>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<span class="gls-margin-xsmall-right" gls-icon="icon: check; ratio: 2"></span>
<span gls-icon="icon: check; ratio: 3.5"></span>
</div>

```html
<span class="gls-margin-xsmall-right" gls-icon="icon: check; ratio: 2"></span>
<span gls-icon="icon: check; ratio: 3.5"></span>
```

---

## Link modifier

To reset the default link styling to a more muted color when using an icon inside an anchor, add the `.gls-icon-link` class.

```html
<a href="" class="gls-icon-link" gls-icon="heart"></a>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div>
    <a href="#" class="gls-icon-link gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="copy"></a>
    <a href="#" class="gls-icon-link gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="file-edit"></a>
    <a href="#" class="gls-icon-link" gls-icon="trash"></a>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div>
    <a href="#" class="gls-icon-link gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="copy"></a>
    <a href="#" class="gls-icon-link gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="file-edit"></a>
    <a href="#" class="gls-icon-link" gls-icon="trash"></a>
</div>
```

---

## Button modifier

Use the modifier `.gls-icon-button` class on an `<a>` element to create an icon button, which can be used for social icons.

```html
<a href="" class="gls-icon-button" gls-icon="instagram"></a>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div>
    <a href="" class="gls-icon-button gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="instagram"></a>
    <a href="" class="gls-icon-button  gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="facebook"></a>
    <a href="" class="gls-icon-button" gls-icon="youtube"></a>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div>
    <a href="" class="gls-icon-button gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="instagram"></a>
    <a href="" class="gls-icon-button  gls-margin-small-right" gls-icon="facebook"></a>
    <a href="" class="gls-icon-button" gls-icon="youtube"></a>
</div>
```

---

## Overlay modifier

Use the modifier `.gls-icon-overlay` class to make the icon work best on background images.

```html
<span class="gls-icon-overlay" gls-icon="play-circle"></span></a>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-child-width-1-2@m" gls-grid>
    <div>

        <a href class="gls-inline gls-dark">
            <img src="images/light.jpg" width="1800" height="1200" alt="">
            <div class="gls-position-center">
                <span class="gls-icon-overlay" href="#" gls-icon="ratio: 3; icon: play-circle"></span>
            </div>
        </a>

    </div>
    <div>

        <a href class="gls-inline gls-light">
            <img src="images/dark.jpg" width="1800" height="1200" alt="">
            <div class="gls-position-center">
                <span class="gls-icon-overlay" href="#" gls-icon="ratio: 3; icon: youtube"></span>
            </div>
        </a>

    </div>

</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-child-width-1-2@m" gls-grid>
    <div>
        <a href class="gls-inline gls-dark">
            <img src="images/light.jpg" width="1800" height="1200" alt="" />
            <div class="gls-position-center">
                <span
                    class="gls-icon-overlay"
                    href="#"
                    gls-icon="ratio: 3; icon: play-circle"
                ></span>
            </div>
        </a>
    </div>
    <div>
        <a href class="gls-inline gls-light">
            <img src="images/dark.jpg" width="1800" height="1200" alt="" />
            <div class="gls-position-center">
                <span class="gls-icon-overlay" href="#" gls-icon="ratio: 3; icon: youtube"></span>
            </div>
        </a>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Image modifier

You can also make any background image scale to the size of an icon. Just add the `.gls-icon-image` class and a background image path.

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<span class="gls-icon gls-icon-image" style="background-image: url(images/dark.jpg);"></span>
</div>

```html
<span class="gls-icon gls-icon-image" style="background-image: url(images/dark.jpg);"></span>
```

---

## Component options

Any of these options can be applied to the component attribute. Separate multiple options with a semicolon. [Learn more](https://getuikit.com/docs/javascript#component-configuration)

| Option  | Value  | Default | Description          |
| ------- | ------ | ------- | -------------------- |
| `icon`  | String |         | The icon to display. |
| `ratio` | Number | `1`     | The icon size ratio. |

`icon` is the _Primary_ option and its key may be omitted, if it's the only option in the attribute value.

```html
<span gls-icon="heart"></span>
```

---

## JavaScript

Learn more about [JavaScript components](https://getuikit.com/docs/javascript#programmatic-use).

### Initialization

```js
UIkit.icon(element, options);
```

### Properties

#### svg

A JavaScript Promise that will resolve with the added SVG Node.

```js
UIkit.icon(element).svg.then(function (svg) {
    svg.querySelector('path').style.stroke = 'red';
});
```

---

## Accessibility

Set the appropriate WAI-ARIA roles, states and properties to the Icon component.

- If an `<a>` element is used, set the `aria-label` property to the `<a>` element to describe its meaning.

```html
<a href="" gls-icon="icon: heart" aria-label="…"></a>
```
